winding_temperature.action_warning: Activate secondary cooling fans and check oil pump status.
winding_temperature.action_critical: Initiate emergency automatic load transfer or trip transformer protection relay to prevent thermal breakdown.

load_percentage.action_critical: Shed or reroute loads within 15 minutes to avoid core degradation.

partial_discharge.action_critical: Trigger online DGA monitor check and alert field technicians for winding insulation inspection.

vibration.action_warning: Inspect mechanical frame bolts and core clamp tension.
vibration.action_critical: Shut down transformer for mechanical integrity audit.

insulation_resistance.action_critical: Isolate unit to prevent catastrophic winding flashover.
